summary: Hiker about 4 miles up East Maroon Trail suffered heart palpitations, shortness of breath and weakness; Mountain Rescue Aspen mobilized 3:55 p.m. and CareFlight flew the hiker to Aspen Valley Hospital about 5 p.m.; rest of party guided out by about 7:30 p.m.
location: East Maroon Trail, ~4 miles up, Maroon Bells Wilderness
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; CareFlight of the Rockies
notes: The Next Summit article published 2024-07-25, retelling the Pitkin County Sheriff's Office release; July 23, 2024 was a Tuesday (Tuesday-verified). Run 1019 chunk B.
